module_role: Partial M-613 MTRACON schedule inventory. It anchors every printed grille/register/diffuser, humidifier, dehumidifier, expansion-tank, cabinet-unit-heater and standalone fan row not already covered by the dedicated MTRACON control-valve module, with concise literal schedule specifications. Plan/controller reconciliation remains open.
